svy = load("svy")
h = svy.hjs - svy.hjs.mean()          # 평균 중심화
r = svy.refl - svy.refl.mean()
b, se, *_ = ols(svy.mil, [h, r, h * r])
print(b.round(3), se.round(3))
# [4.833 0.987 0.042 0.192] [0.042 0.052 0.031 0.039]

b2, se2, *_ = ols(svy.mil, [svy.hjs, svy.refl, svy.hjs * svy.refl])
print(b2.round(3), se2.round(3))
# [ 4.041  0.12  -0.92   0.192] [0.874 0.177 0.196 0.039]
print(round(np.corrcoef(svy.hjs, svy.hjs * svy.refl)[0, 1], 3),
      round(np.corrcoef(h, h * r)[0, 1], 3))
# 0.641 -0.117

exp = load("exp")                                    # 3장의 실험판 (366명)
k = exp.mil_t1 - exp.mil_t1.mean()                   # 기저 의미만 중심화
bu, _, pu, _ = ols(exp.mil, [exp.cond, exp.mil_t1, exp.cond * exp.mil_t1])
bc, _, pc, _ = ols(exp.mil, [exp.cond, k, exp.cond * k])
print(round(bu[1], 2), round(pu[1], 3), round(bu[3], 2))
print(round(bc[1], 2), round(pc[1], 3), round(bc[3], 2))
# 0.18 0.667 0.02
# 0.29 0.007 0.02

sd = svy.refl.std(ddof=1)
print(round(sd, 3), [float(round(b[1] + b[3] * v, 3)) for v in (-sd, 0, sd)])
# 1.338 [0.731, 0.987, 1.244]

med = svy.refl.median()
for lab, sub in [("하위", svy[svy.refl <= med]), ("상위", svy[svy.refl > med])]:
    bs, *_ = ols(sub.mil, [sub.hjs])
    print(lab, len(sub), round(bs[1], 3))
# 하위 435 0.873
# 상위 131 1.438

med, sd, m = svy.refl.median(), svy.refl.std(ddof=1), svy.refl.mean()
for lab, sub in [("하위", svy[svy.refl <= med]), ("상위", svy[svy.refl > med])]:
    print(lab, round((sub.refl.mean() - m) / sd, 2))
# 하위 -0.4
# 상위 1.31
